label: training-gym-r60-complete
context:
Training Gym R60 completed! ALL 4 PASS ON FIRST TRY including 3 TIER 9!

R60 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. astar-search-001 (T8) - A* search with heuristic. Priority queue on f=g+h. Admissible heuristic guarantees optimal.
2. suffix-array-001 (T9) - Suffix array O(n log^2 n). Sort by (rank[i], rank[i+k]), double k. Pattern search via binary search on sorted suffixes.
3. lazy-segment-tree-001 (T9) - Segment tree with lazy propagation. Range add + range sum. Push lazy to children before recursing.
4. ford-fulkerson-001 (T9) - Edmonds-Karp max flow. BFS augmenting paths in residual graph. Forward+backward edges. Classic result: flow=23.

DB: 277 exercises, 479 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.6% perfect. 225 passed. Tier 9+ = 58.
26+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.
decisions: A*: priority queue on f=g+h. Counter for tie-breaking. Skip stale entries where f > g[u]+h(u).
Suffix array: sort by (rank[i], rank[i+k]), recompute ranks, double k. Break when max rank = n-1.
Lazy segment tree: tree[] for sums, lazy[] for pending adds. Push: add lazy*len to children's tree, accumulate children's lazy.
Edmonds-Karp: BFS in residual graph. Edge = [to, capacity, rev_index]. Update: forward.cap -= flow, reverse.cap += flow.
next_steps: R61: Design more exercises. Try: LRU Cache, Interval Tree, Trie with delete, or DP problems.
